auto-memory-evolution v1.0.0

- Adds automatic daily aggregation of discussion summaries at a scheduled time.
- Introduces idle detection: if no user activity for 45 minutes, triggers memory saving.
- Archives daily discussion points into dated memory files and long-term MEMORY.md.
- Provides easy setup via scheduled cron jobs and configurable parameters.
- Includes scripts for daily summary and heartbeat-based checking.
